# E2-T08 · Asynchronous export engine: ExportJob, worker, limits, signed downloads (S14 WP-14-C)

## Objective
Work package WP-14-C: large exports run in the background with a per-club limit and expiring download links.

## Spec references
S14 R-14-12 (file names, `hmac16`), §3 `ExportJob {status QUEUED|RUNNING|READY|FAILED, downloadUrl (signed, 7 days), rows, format, requestedBy}`, R-14-13 (limit 2 running jobs per club → `429 EXPORT_LIMIT`), retention (exports 7 days per `docs/DECISIONS_PENDENTS.md` A18d) · tests **T-14-10, T-14-15, T-14-16**.

## Context to load
S14 §3, §4 (export rules), §6 rows `/exports*`, §11 · E2-T07 renderers · this file.

## Steps
1. `ExportJob` collection + worker (`@Scheduled` poller claiming `QUEUED` jobs with `findAndModify`, one at a time per instance), renderers reused from E2-T07 streaming to S3 (or local storage in `local` profile), signed URL 7 days, TTL cleanup 7 days.
2. `GET /exports`, `GET /exports/{id}`, `POST /{resource}/export` → `202 {jobId}` when > 5 000 rows (E2-T07 threshold), `429 EXPORT_LIMIT` on the 3rd running job.
3. File naming `{clubSlug}_{resource}_{yyyyMMdd-HHmm}.xlsx` (club local time), `hmac16(email)` helper for pseudonymous exports (T-14-10).

## Verification (run all; paste full output in the report)
- `./mvnw -q verify` → green with T-14-10, T-14-15 (xlsx header in the requester's locale, IBAN masked), T-14-16 (5 001 rows → 202 → READY with signed URL; 3rd job → 429).

## Definition of Done
Worker + endpoints + limits + cleanup tested.

## Evidence to return
`verify` output.

---

## Executor report
Implemented E2-T08. Final `./mvnw -q verify`: 251 unit/contract tests + 371 integration tests, zero failures/errors/skips; all coverage gates pass. OpenAPI matches the generated snapshot. The local image builds and its private export volume survives container recreation. No remote image publication or live S3 access was performed.

### Branch / commits
Working tree only. No Git write commands, branches, commits or pushes. The session publisher owns publication.

### Evidence (full command outputs)
All required verify attempts and their complete stdout/stderr are included below, followed by OpenAPI and storage checks. Tokens/hashes are truncated as required by AGENTS.md; no log lines are omitted (trailing whitespace is normalized). Maven uses a writable wrapper/repository cache under `/tmp`; Docker Buildx similarly uses a writable activity directory.

- Verify 1: the export tests passed; the two production-profile security tests lacked the newly required S3 fixture settings. Added generated fictional credentials to their existing fixture.
- Verify 2: after a clean build, macOS aborted the JVM during PDF rasterization because the earlier PDF test initialized AWT before a test-local headless setting. Set headless mode for both test JVM plugins.
- Verify 3: passed. Subsequent review separated the default scheduler from the dedicated export scheduler and added a negative authentication test.
- Verify 4: only the new forged-impersonation assertion failed (expected 403; the existing authentication layer returns 401 for a claim without a stored grant). Corrected the expectation; application-level impersonation rejection remains covered separately.
- Verify 5: passed. The final storage review then moved host-local files outside Maven's clean directory and supplied writable persistent container volumes.
- Verify 6: final passing build, including the storage configuration and private-file permission check.

### Rules and tests implemented (R-xx-nn / T-xx-nn)
- R-14-12, T-14-10: club-local filenames; keyed HMAC-SHA256 truncated to 16 hex characters, normalized emails, stable results and 10,000 distinct fictional inputs.
- R-14-12, T-14-15: requester-locale XLSX/PDF column labels and values, club-zone dates, money/booleans, IBAN/chip/identity-document masking, string cells, streamed workbook rows and bounded PDF line handling. Inline exports now retain READY jobs. Completion, DATA_EXPORTED audit and DataExported outbox writes commit/roll back together.
- R-14-12, T-14-16: actual 5,001-row POST → QUEUED → RUNNING → READY → signed download; actual 100,001-row rejection; two concurrent RUNNING jobs per club; fenced concurrent claims, stale-lease rejection and recovery; three attempts before FAILED; 10 exports/10 minutes per account across clubs; caller/tenant/role checks; expired-link rejection; retried file deletion before TTL.
- T-14-16: local private files/signature tampering/expiry, S3 SDK upload/get/delete/presigning with a test double, worker reentry/failure isolation, and transactional completion rollback. Container smoke verifies UID 10001, directory mode 0700, file mode 0600 and persistence across replacement containers.
- Existing E2-T07 list/inline export tests remain green with localized headers. Existing E2 contract tests now exclude implemented lifecycle routes from the 501 stub matrix. The production security fixture supplies the new S3 configuration; no security assertions were removed.

### Assumptions
- E2-T07 is verified; no dependency is awaiting verification. This session implements only E2-T08.
- The closed error catalog and the organizer's E2-T01 ruling govern statuses: EXPORT_LIMIT and EXPORT_EXPIRED remain 422. The task's concurrency reference is R-14-12, not the member-data rule R-14-13. Seven-day files and seven-day signed URLs follow this task/A18d over the older S14 24-hour/five-minute text.
- The existing durable handoff's ownerAccountId remains the requester field. Query/columns/locale/timezone/filename are frozen; rows are read when rendered, not stored as a submission-time data snapshot. Legacy queued jobs freeze missing presentation fields on their first attempt. Current provider/module allowlists are revalidated during rendering.
- Only the registered member/dog LIST providers are implemented here. Other export resources, MEMBER_DATA/ACCOUNTING production, notification delivery and RGPD erasure remain their owning verticals. hmac16 accepts the caller's secret; no erasure or pseudonymous export workflow is invented.
- PDF reuses E2-T07's club-name/color layout, adding localized values/page totals and landscape mode. The full S14 logo/filter/requester-subtitle layout is not part of that renderer's existing contract and remains a documented integration boundary.
- Five-minute renewable worker leases, three attempts, a dedicated one-thread export scheduler and an independent default scheduler keep long exports separate from outbox polling. Attempt-specific object keys prevent stale writers overwriting successors. Storage files are deleted at expiry; only successfully cleaned EXPIRED tombstones get a TTL seven days later. This preserves an explicit expired-link response without allowing Mongo TTL to orphan files.
- Staging/prod requires private S3 configuration; the SDK's request is bounded below the worker lease. Configure an exports-prefix bucket lifecycle as a crash-cleanup backstop. No real credentials/bucket were available or needed for the local/test work: S3 is verified through its SDK and a test double, while local storage is exercised end to end.
- Local downloads require bearer ownership plus a signature. Local signing is ephemeral unless EXPORT_SIGNING_KEY is provided; existing files can receive fresh links after restart. Host-local files use ignored .local/exports; tests use target/test-exports; both development Compose variants mount a private persistent /app/exports volume. No Git write operation was attempted.
